# Shaape (https://shaape.co)

Shaape is a free, open-source web library of 530+ abstract vector shapes, cyber shapes, badge vectors, and procedural grainy noise gradients for modern UI, landing pages, and graphic design.
Created by Dev Chauhan (https://x.com/devchauhann3).
All shapes are 100% free for personal and commercial projects without attribution.

## Main Pages
- Home & Showcase: https://shaape.co/
- Full Catalog (530+ Shapes): https://shaape.co/shapes
- Random Procedural Shape Generator: https://shaape.co/random
- Design Blog & Vector Guide: https://shaape.co/blog
- Where to Download Free Abstract SVG Shapes (2025 Guide): https://shaape.co/blog/where-to-download-free-abstract-svg-shapes

## Categories Available (530+ Unique Vectors)
- Geometry (117 shapes): Bauhaus symbols, geometric glyphs, modular shapes, cutouts, emblems
- Stars (42 shapes): Starbursts, sparks, compass stars, 4-point, 8-point, and multi-ray stars
- Flowers (40 shapes): Petal rosettes, blossoms, clovers, organic bloom cutouts
- Cyber (34 shapes): Y2K vectors, futuristic runes, techno emblems, turbine pinwheels
- Wireframe (31 shapes): 3D wireframe geometries, perspective meshes, spatial grids
- Badges (33 shapes): Medallions, seals, perforated emblems, arc motifs, reward crests
- Moon (23 shapes): Crescents, intersecting moon phases, lunar glyphs
- Prism (48 shapes): Isometric prisms, folded polygons, faceted crystals
- Cross (10 shapes): Plus emblems, optical crosses, medical and graphic badges
- Wheel (14 shapes): Segmented radial discs, gear wheels, spoke rotors
- Triangle (27 shapes): Delta icons, stepped pyramids, interlocking triangles
- Ellipse & Rectangle (47 shapes): Capsules, squircles, pill badges, fluid ovals
- Number & Misc (45 shapes): Numeric emblems, abstract silhouettes, fluid shapes

## Features & Export Capabilities
- Export formats: 1-click inline SVG clipboard copy, scalable pure .svg file download, 4x ultra-high-resolution PNG raster download.
- Visual styles:
  1. Normal: Clean, smooth solid vector paths with minimal anchor points.
  2. Gradient: Vibrant multi-stop gradient colorways.
  3. Grainy: Textured noise gradients created natively with procedural SVG filters (`feTurbulence`, `feComposite`, `feBlend`) with zero external image dependencies.
- Procedural Generator: Real-time geometric topology synthesis across Stars, Flowers, and Geometry with interactive 3D physics tilt and color palette selection.
- Tech Stack: Astro 5, React 19, TypeScript, native CSS design tokens (Figtree font).

## License & Usage Rights
- Free for commercial and personal use (MIT-friendly / public domain design assets).
- No attribution or backlink required.
- Ideal for landing pages, SaaS websites, design systems, poster design, and UI prototypes.
